name: Inferior
overview: Scripture reveals that no person is inherently inferior in the sight of God, as all are created by one Father and share equal standing before Him (Malachi 2:10; Galatians 3:28). Even when facing daunting challenges or opposition, believers are assured of God's presence and strength, which overcomes human limitations (Deuteronomy 20:1). The book of Job emphasizes that understanding and value are not determined by status or appearance, affirming that no one is truly lower or inferior to another (Job 12:3). This unity and equality are grounded in the divine calling and purpose revealed by the Lord (Jeremiah 1:4).
